statement: ∀ (G : Type) [Group G] (f : G → Nat) (a b c k : G), Function.Injective f → f (a * k) = f (b * k) → f (b * k) = f (c * k) → a = c
∀ (f : ℝ → Nat) (a b c : ℝ), Function.Injective f → f a = f b → f b = f c → a ≤ c
∀ (f : List Nat → Nat) (a b c : List Nat), Function.Injective f → f a = f b → f b = f c → a.length = c.length
∀ (f : Nat → Nat) (a b c : Nat) (s : Set Nat), Function.Injective f → f a = f b → f b = f c → a ∈ s → c ∈ s
